finding.claim: MEDIUM (blind SSRF, reachable without authentication in this file). The unauthenticated POST /hooks/test route passes the request body's `callback` value straight to axios.post as the URL. Any caller can make the server send a POST to an arbitrary host or scheme, including internal services, loopback and cloud metadata addresses. Only the response status is returned, so this is blind SSRF (port scanning and internal reachability probing). axios follows redirects by default, so an attacker-hosted URL can also redirect the request to internal targets. Mounting of the `pub` router is not in this repo, so any global auth middleware could not be checked.
